description: This Java source file defines a web filter named CacheFilter within the org.apache.ofbiz.base.util package. Its primary purpose is to intercept HTTP requests and responses to implement caching-related logic, specifically to prevent security issues by controlling request processing. The class implements the jakarta.servlet.Filter interface and overrides key lifecycle methods such as doFilter, init, and destroy.

classes.name: CacheFilter
classes.description: A servlet filter class that processes and intercepts HTTP requests/responses to handle caching logic and security concerns within the OFBiz framework.

methods.name: doFilter
methods.description: Implementation of the Filter interface method; processes incoming requests, obtains URI without context, and forwards request/response through filter chain.
